Lot of Joy and Beauparc are others to consider.

selections.comment: CAREFREE DREAM has had the two runs in her career so far, both of which have come at this venue. Now it was her 2nd last time out that would suggest she is up to winning a contest of this nature, where she came 2nd behind a Ralph Beckett first-time-out winner who is very well bred. She was always keeping on towards the line and was only beaten by three quarters of a length in the end, always keeping on well in the closing stages. With no real standout here in terms of debutants, she is expected to go one place better here and win. Amazing Journey finished fourth on debut, which was a good run, but he was a shade too green throughout; he will no doubt know his job better here and go well once again. And Magic Stone hails from a top yard who do well with their youngsters; he would have learnt plenty from the debut experience and will fill the places here.

selections.comment: A very tricky contest on paper, OLDBURY LAD seems to be the only one that could really take a step forward and looks the sort to improve still. He is yet to win in eight career runs but did place in her last two runs. It was the 2nd place finish last time out that really catches the eye, as he was hampered badly in the closing stages, and although it is hard to say if he might have won, he would have certainly got closer to the winner that day and made it a real test for them. He is expected to build on that here and finally get his head in front. Endowed would be an easy winner of this race if he could reproduce his form from years ago; he once won off the mark of 71 previously but is not the force of old; however, he was a winner last time out. He will no doubt go very well here once again. Diamond Cottage was a winner here on her penultimate start, and she can bounce back from the disappointment from last time out and fill the places here.

selections.comment: Grace Harris has two runners in this contest, and it should come as no surprise should she land 1st and 2nd in this race. CONNIE'S ROSE was a very decent neck 2nd at this venue last time out when trying to make all. That was over 6 furlongs; this 5 furlongs might actually suit her running style. She likes to burst out of the gates and make all, showing some pretty nice early race speed in the process. If she can get to the front early on, she will be hard to peg back here. So Smart is the yard's other runner, who was a winner over this trip at Lingfield a few starts back; he has plenty of speed and will no doubt be finishing the race nicely. Honour Your Dreams has been in great form during the early stages of this season, but he might have to just settle for another 3rd place finish here.

selections.comment: KAMEKIST has only won one race in six career starts, but he is by far the one that could improve past these with the more racing he has. A winner off the mark of 68 at Wolverhampton over the 6-furlong trip, he has been unlucky since then, not getting a clear run at Windsor in May before potentially not seeing out the 7-furlong trip at Haydock on his last run. Back down to 6 furlongs now, although currently operating off a career-high mark, he could improve and land a contest of this nature. Over Spiced has been in terrific form for Grace Harris since coming to her yard from Paul Attwater's. Her filly was a winner two starts ago and was a good 2nd last time out; she can run well and notch up another placed effort to her name. Jax Edge has not run in 200+ days; however, he was in good winning form before that and could run well here before improving for the run.

selections.comment: Not the strongest contest on paper at all, therefore this could be the perfect opportunity for the lightly raced LAMBOURNGHINI to get her head in front here. She has only had five career runs so far, and she has seemingly got better with each passing run. A 2nd at Ripon on her penultimate start, she then went on to come 4th at Yarmouth last time out in what was a much stronger race than this on paper. She is the only real sort who could improve enough to win this race, and she hails from a very shrewd yard that knows how to win with her type. Ajrad runs off the same mark as when he last won, and although his form since then has been a little patchy, this would be one of the easier races he has raced in recently; he can go well and get a place here. Letter of the Law comes from a yard that does well here, and he is 4 lb lower than his last winning mark; he could go well and fill the places here.

Coco Hill was once rated nearly 70, therefore was a decent animal, and although he has regressed since then, he can run well and place here.
